hospital-clinic.name: Rapid Testing in Hospitals & Clinics
hospital-clinic.overview: Point-of-care rapid tests speed triage in emergency departments and clinics — cardiac markers for chest pain, infectious-disease tests for fever, and inflammation markers for sepsis risk.

pharmacy-retail.name: Rapid Testing in Pharmacy & Retail
pharmacy-retail.overview: High-volume consumer and near-patient tests for pharmacy retail — pregnancy, ovulation, and common self-test formats.

workplace-drug.name: Workplace Drug Testing
workplace-drug.overview: Drug-of-abuse screening for workplace and occupational-health programs — single-analyte tests and integrated multi-panel cups with adulteration checks.

blood-bank-antenatal.name: Blood Bank & Antenatal Screening
blood-bank-antenatal.overview: Transfusion-transmissible infection screening (HBsAg, HCV, HIV, syphilis) for blood banks and antenatal programs.

public-health.name: Public Health & Outbreak Programs
public-health.overview: Field-ready rapid tests for disease surveillance, outbreak response and NGO/government tender programs — dengue, malaria, cholera, typhoid and tropical pathogens.
